page_text:
March 15, 2018 

Denise McNerney, Merits Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
1 First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re:  Vernon Madison v. State of Alabama, No. 17-7505 

Dear Ms. McNerney: 

On  behalf  of  counsel  for  both  parties  in  this  case,  I  am  writing  to  request 
that the time for  filing the initial briefs for both the Petitioner, Vernon Madison, 
and  the  Respondent,  State  of  Alabama,  each  be  extended  by  forty  (40)  days. 
Certiorari was granted in this case on February 26, 2018, and Petitioner’s brief on 
the  merits  is  currently  due  on  April  12,  2018.    If  the  requested  extension  is 
granted,  Petitioner’s  brief  would  be  due  on  May  22,  2018  and  Respondent’s  brief 
would  be  due  on  July  31,  2018.    The  parties  have  agreed  that  Petitioner’s  reply 
brief would be filed within the requisite 30 day time period, or by August 30, 2018. 

Thank you for your assistance in this matter. 

Sincerely,  

/s/ Bryan A. Stevenson 
Bryan A. Stevenson 
Counsel of Record for Petitioner Vernon Madison 

cc: 

Andrew Brasher, Office of the Solicitor General of the State of Alabama 
James Houts, Office of the Attorney General of the State of Alabama
